- **Datadog (thousands)**  
  750,671 + 6,373 + 53,799 + 1,574 = **812,417 thousand**, which equals **$812.417 million**.  
  [DOC: all_three_tables.txt]

All three reconciliations are for different fiscal years (Workday FY2026, ServiceNow FY2025, Datadog FY2025), so the periods are **not strictly comparable**.
